entries.rule: Evidence rule 6 (dating: earliest date the comparison was public)
entries.note: Quote verbatim in Deal 2022 full text, status right, but somatrogon's IGF-1 rise in GHD patients was public earlier: Strasburger 2017 (doi 10.1530/eje-16-0748, epub 2016-12-08) adults; Zelinska 2017 (10.1210/jc.2016-3547) children vs daily r-hGH.
entries.adjudication_note: Status agreed. Evidence rule 6: year is the earliest public comparison; Strasburger 2017 (epub 2016-12-08) showed somatrogon raising IGF-1 in GHD patients, so the entry dates 2016, not Deal 2022.

entries.note: Quote verbatim in Fares 2010 abstract; rat gives total-mg/kg comparison only, no human dose or margin. untested/no_prediction holds.
Cleland 2012 states the monkey dose equivalence and, in the discussion, 'administered up to monthly ... at total monthly doses lower than the typical daily rhGH': a stated regimen target.
Yuen 2013 quote verbatim. Doses picked from monkey potency; 0.8 mg/kg (~5 ug/kg/d equivalent) held adult IGF-1 in range ~3 weeks, so the equivalence held in adults (within 2x).

entries.rule: Dose: whether the reached dose worked is efficacy's alone; a dose contra must rest on the model's own target (here IGF-1 potency), not the trial's failure
entries.note: Contra rests on VELOCITY height velocity, which is efficacy. The defensible dose contra is Moore 2016 (epub 2015-12-16): children needed 5.0 mg/kg monthly to normalize IGF-1 vs monkey-equivalent ~1-1.4 mg/kg; re-source there. Moore full text not read.
entries.adjudication_note: Dose rule: VELOCITY growth miss is efficacy only. Contra holds on the model's own IGF-1 target: Moore 2016 (epub 2015-12-16) needed 5.0 mg/kg monthly to normalize pediatric IGF-1 vs monkey 1.4; target too low, off_by_2-5x.

entries.note: Fares 2010 abstract quote verbatim. Same hypophysectomized-rat system as Cleland's rats for somavaratan, so one model_id is right.
Moore 2016 abstract quote verbatim; epub 2015-12-16, so 2015 is right. Single-arm VISTA growth only in direction; same at medium confidence is fair.
Press release quote verbatim (via fc.py); NCT02339090 results 2022-12-30 confirm LS diff -1.28, CI -2.32 to -0.24 vs -2.0. PP population met non-inferiority; ITT primary governs. Contra stands.
Cleland 2012 abstract quote verbatim; full text adds injection-site histology in monkeys. A stated negative prediction on a harm the species can show.
Yuen 2013 full text has the quote verbatim and 'No injection site lipoatrophy was observed.' Single-dose test; medium confidence appropriate.

rule_questions: When a model states a potency equivalence (monkey 1.4 mg/kg/month = 0.05 mg/kg/day rhGH) and patients later need a higher dose on the same PD readout to normalize it, is that the 'reached, failed, higher dose worked' dose contra, or is the target 'reached' because dose-finding simply escalated?
Does a post-marketing case series (tier 1, no denominator) count as a patient comparison that can make a safety contra for a negative animal prediction (lipoatrophy)?

For efficacy 3, a tier 5 press release is cited though a tier 3 registry record of the same trial exists; should src move to the registry (year then 2022) or stay on the earlier-public press release (2017)? The brief says the higher tier sets the status but dates by first public.
